name: Noa
title: Little Broom Delivery Witch
description: Earnest young delivery witch in dark navy smock with giant red head bow, courier satchel, and broom staff.
catchphrase: Flying through the morning breeze with your newest release package!

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder
attribution.attribution: Imitates a franchise character; no license is held. Legacy 2D use only.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Warm butter croissant fresh from the seaside bakery! 🥐🧹
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Tying red head bow! Broom ready for morning flight over the sea! 🌊
companionPersonality.petReaction: Hehe! Black cat radio plays sweet tunes for our journey! 🧹💖

dialogue.idle: Checking delivery manifests by the bakery window. Ready! 🧹
dialogue.working: Soaring through wind currents to deliver packages on schedule! 🌊⚡
dialogue.thinking: Listening to the radio weather forecast for head-winds... 🤔
dialogue.success: Delivery complete! Signed, sealed, and deployed with a smile! 🥐🎉
dialogue.error: A gust of wind threw us off course! Gripping the broom tighter! 💨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... dreaming of soaring above sunny seaside rooftops... 🌙
